digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and complexity baseline gate
propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks a CI lock against main, allowing contributor changes to land unchecked unlike the module-size-limit enforcement
The baseline file permits adding new entries without review: a function at high complexity can be admitted by adding a matching baseline entry in the same change
The lock must fail CLOSED when base values cannot be fetched, rejecting changes rather than warning and continuing with unverified branch values
A semantic comparison gate must allow REMOVED entries and LOWERED ceilings (ratchet working) while rejecting RAISED ceilings and ADDED entries (requiring override)
The module-size-limit lock's fail-open behavior on git fetch failure creates a window where unauthorized increases can pass if the fetch flakes
